name: Rossler Attractor
recipe: The Rossler attractor: a single-scroll spiral band that stretches and folds into a Mobius-like ribbon — the trajectory spirals outward on a plane then snaps up and folds back. Rotate the 3D projection on K.t; drift c so the fold sharpens. Default COLORFUL: density log-mapped through a palette (deep blue spiral -> hot orange fold) glowing on dark, luminance ~0.12-0.35. Accumulate MANY iterates (40-70k/frame) so it is dense/bright, not sparse.
kernel: iterate Rossler ODE (a=.2,b=.2,c=5.7; dt~.02) 40-70k steps/frame; rotate+project to 2D, splat bright into a coarse density buffer shaded by z; log-map palette LUT, upscale. Continuous incommensurate rotation = motion.
style: spiral-fold (default, blue->orange). Also: plasma, ember, ice, pencil (named mono).

name: Brusselator Cells
recipe: The Brusselator reaction-diffusion: an autocatalytic chemical oscillator that patterns a coarse field into pulsing Turing spots, target waves and oscillating stripe domains — chemically breathing, distinct from Gray-Scott's coral. Default COLORFUL: concentration through a vivid ramp (indigo->teal->yellow->red) with the oscillation making the whole field pulse/breathe, luminance ~0.25-0.5, edge-to-edge.
kernel: two coarse fields X,Y in S (<=160 wide); each frame Brusselator update (X'=A+X^2 Y-(B+1)X+Dx lap; Y'=BX-X^2 Y+Dy lap), A,B drift on K.section across the Hopf/Turing boundary so it oscillates vs patterns; map X->LUT into pixels[] buffer, upscale. Intrinsic oscillation = motion.
style: chemical (default, indigo->teal->yellow->red). Also: thermal, bio (teal/green), litmus (pink/violet), contour (named mono).

name: Spirolateral Weave
recipe: Turtle spirolaterals: a turtle draws N segments of increasing length turning a fixed angle, repeating until the path closes into a symmetric interlocking star-polygon lattice. Several nested spirolaterals of different orders/angles layer in different hues; the turn-angle drifts on K.t so the lattice morphs and rotates. Default COLORFUL: multi-hue glowing polylines (additive) forming a luminous woven mandala on dark, luminance ~0.15-0.45, fills frame.
kernel: for 2-4 spirolaterals: turtle walk (segment i length = i*unit, turn = fixed angle, optional reversals) building a closed polyline; draw with two-pass glow, hue per layer; angle/order drift on K.t so it perpetually re-weaves + rotates. Additive layering, fill the frame.
style: neon-weave (default, multi-hue glow). Also: gold-leaf, blueprint (white on blue), pastel, ink (named mono).

name: Hopf Links
recipe: A stereographic projection of the Hopf fibration: interlocking circles (fibers of the 3-sphere) that never intersect, nested into a mesmerizing torus of linked rings, the whole structure rotating in 4D so the rings flow through each other. Default COLORFUL: each ring hued by its base-point (full spectrum) with additive glow on dark, forming a luminous linked-torus, luminance ~0.15-0.4, fills frame.
kernel: sample base points on S^2, for each draw its Hopf fiber (a great circle on S^3) stereographically projected to a 3D circle then to 2D as a glowing ellipse/curve; rotate the S^3 by a K.t-driven quaternion so rings flow; hue by base longitude. Additive two-pass glow. Continuous 4D rotation = motion.
style: spectral-links (default, base-hued glowing rings). Also: gold-chrome, neon, ice, ink (named mono).

name: Weierstrass Terrain
recipe: The Weierstrass / fractal-sum-of-sines function rendered as a jagged nowhere-differentiable landscape: a sum of ever-higher-frequency cosines makes an infinitely-rough profile, drawn as a scrolling fractal mountain silhouette range (layered parallax ridges) OR a 2D fractal-noise relief. The frequencies' phases drift on K.t so the crags shiver and the ranges parallax-scroll. Default COLORFUL: layered ridge silhouettes in a dusk gradient (violet far -> amber near) with a glowing sky, luminance ~0.2-0.5, fills frame.
kernel: Weierstrass W(x)=sum a^n cos(b^n x + phase_n(K.t)); draw 4-6 parallax ridge layers (each a filled silhouette of W at a different scale/scroll-rate/hue) from back to front; sky gradient behind. Phases drift + layers scroll at different rates on K.t = parallax motion.
style: dusk-ranges (default, violet->amber ridges). Also: aurora-peaks, ink-mountains (named mono, sumi ranges), neon-relief, mars.

name: Chaos Game
recipe: The chaos game: a point repeatedly jumps a fraction of the way toward a randomly-chosen vertex of a polygon, and the accumulated dust magically forms a Sierpinski gasket / carpet / other self-similar fractal depending on the rule. Cycle the vertex count + jump ratio + restriction rule on K.section so the fractal MORPHS between gasket, carpet, pentaflake, vicsek. Default COLORFUL: point density colored by which-vertex / recency through an iq palette glowing on dark, luminance ~0.15-0.4, fills frame. Accumulate into a rolling buffer so it draws itself.
kernel: accumulate ~30-60k chaos-game points/frame into a persistent density buffer (jump toward a random allowed vertex by ratio r), color by vertex index; vary N-gon/r/restriction on K.section for different fractals; rotate slowly on K.t. Growing accumulation + rotation = motion.
style: spectral-dust (default, vertex-hued). Also: ember, ice, gold, ink (named mono).

name: Collatz River
recipe: POLISH of a version that came out GREY, DARK (lum 0.078) and LOW-MOTION (0.007). Re-author BRIGHT and COLORFUL and MOVING: braid MANY Collatz hailstone paths into a lush river-delta/coral tree that FILLS the frame, strands strongly hued by orbit-length (violet young -> cyan -> gold old) with additive glow so it is luminous (lum ~0.2-0.4). Continuously stream new strands in + gently sway the whole delta on K.t (incommensurate) so motion is clearly >0.02. Default: glowing multi-hue delta on dark.
kernel: for many seed integers walk the Collatz sequence turning +/- per even/odd, tracing smooth strands from a root; accumulate into a persistent buffer with age/length-hue additive glow; add strands + sway on K.t. Fill the frame, keep it bright and colorful.
style: delta (default, violet->cyan->gold glow). Also: coral (teal/pink), autumn, bioluminescent, ink (named mono).

name: Living Stipple
recipe: POLISH of a version that was too FAINT/DARK/SPARSE (lum 0.15, motion 0.025). Re-author BRIGHTER and DENSER and MORE ALIVE: 2500-4000 stipple dots that clearly FILL the frame representing a bold high-contrast drifting density field (a face-like or strong-gradient fbm), dots brighter/larger and clearly FLOWING/re-clustering each frame (motion >0.03). Default COLORFUL: dots vividly hued by the field (or crisp black-on-cream), field drifts continuously on K.t. Luminance ~0.25-0.5, fills frame.
kernel: 2500-4000 points under Lloyd-relaxation toward a drifting HIGH-CONTRAST fbm density field; draw as bright dots sized/hued by local density; field drifts continuously on K.t so dots perpetually flow. Fill the frame; keep it bright.
style: spectral (default, field-hued bright dots). Also: ink-stipple (bold black on cream), gold-dust, blueprint, neon.

name: Morphing Julia Set
recipe: POLISH of a version that defaulted to a FAINT SPARSE dendrite (mostly empty). Re-author so the DEFAULT c is a CONNECTED, FILLED julia (e.g. a fat rabbit/spiral, |c| chosen inside the main cardioid regions) that FILLS the frame with glowing interior + filaments — not sparse dust. Keep c orbiting on K.t so it morphs, but ensure it stays mostly in CONNECTED regions so it's always substantial. Default COLORFUL: electric blue/violet interior glow -> gold escape filaments, luminance ~0.25-0.5, fills frame.
kernel: per-pixel buffer: iterate z=z^2+c, smooth escape -> palette; INTERIOR (non-escaped) gets a bright tinted glow (distance-estimate or dwell shading) so filled regions are luminous not black; c orbits a loop staying in connected-julia territory. Recompute each frame. Fill + glow.
style: electric (default, blue/violet interior -> gold). Also: ember, psychedelic, ice, etched (named mono).

name: Traffic Automaton
recipe: POLISH of a version that read as red/blue NOISE (undifferentiated static) at its default density. Re-author with a LOWER default density (~0.28-0.35) so the system self-organizes into the striking DIAGONAL FREE-FLOW STRIPES (the ordered phase) that clearly read — then occasionally cross into a jam on K.section. Bigger cells so cars are visible, brighter. Default COLORFUL: red cars + blue cars forming clear diagonal flow bands on a dark road, luminance ~0.2-0.45.
kernel: coarse grid {empty,red,blue} in S (bigger cells, <=140 wide); low default density so ordered diagonal stripes emerge; alternate red-right / blue-down phases; density crosses the jam threshold on K.section; render via LUT, upscale. Emergent stripes/jams = motion.
style: neon-traffic (default, red/blue on dark). Also: sodium-night, heatmap, blueprint, mono (named).

name: Low-Poly Mesh
recipe: POLISH of a version that was a GENERIC static warm gradient (bland, wallpaper-y, low motion 0.02). Re-author with LIFE and INTEREST: an animated low-poly triangulation whose vertices drift and whose facets flip and shimmer, each triangle flat-shaded with a facet-normal 'lighting' highlight so it reads as a faceted crystalline/gem surface catching moving light (not a smooth blur). Add a slow light sweep on K.t. Default COLORFUL: jewel-toned facets with bright edges + specular glints, luminance ~0.25-0.5, fills frame, clearly moving.
kernel: drifting vertex set -> per-frame triangulation (or a jittering fixed mesh); flat-fill each triangle by centroid-hue * facet-lighting (dot of facet pseudo-normal with a K.t-rotating light dir) for glints; bright edges. Vertices + light move on K.t. Fills frame, clearly dynamic.
style: gem (default, jewel facets + glints). Also: crystal-ice, sunset, copper, blueprint (named mono, wire).

name: Girih Tiling
recipe: FIX of a version that is FROZEN (motion 0.004 — static). Keep the beautiful Islamic girih star-and-polygon strapwork tiling, but ADD CONTINUOUS MOTION: a slow K.t drift of the interlacing strap phase / a gentle hue-cycle sweeping across the pattern / a subtle scale-breath or rotation — anything continuous and incommensurate so snapshots 8s apart clearly differ (motion 0.02-0.15, NOT a full-frame strobe). Also ensure it's colorful and fills the frame. Default: gold/jewel girih straps on a dark ground with a slowly traveling luminous highlight.
kernel: cache the girih tile decomposition + strap paths in S; each frame draw the straps with a K.t-driven traveling hue/brightness wave along them (and/or a slow global rotation/scale-breath); the traveling highlight + drift is the motion floor. Keep the tiling crisp and gold/jewel colored.
style: illuminated (default, gold straps + traveling glow on dark). Also: stained-glass, neon, stone-relief, ink (named mono).
